narrative.details: I followed the legend of that Stalvan character for years.  When those visiting nobles were slaughtered a few years back I went with Haggard to investigate.  I found these muddy pages but we were never able to link the handwriting to that crazy man in the woods.  Your trail of evidence proves his guilt.  Take this to Commander Ebonlocke immediately and fill her in on what you've discovered!
narrative.objectives: Take the muddy page to Commander Ebonlocke.
narrative.offerRewardText: My, you have proved yourself to be quite a detective, Champion.
narrative.requestItemsText: This better be good, Champion. Let me see what you have and tell me your tale. But by the Light, be quick about it. Darkshire's defense is my number one priority. I have not the time to squander on dead-end leads.

chain.subtitle: 13 quests from level 28 to 35, 13,250 XP in all.

quests.objectiveText: Seek out the Clerk Daltry in the Darkshire Town Hall.

quests.name: The Legend of Stalvan
quests.objectiveText: Travel to the Moonbrook Schoolhouse and bring back any updated information about Stalvan to Clerk Daltry.

quests.name: The Legend of Stalvan
quests.objectiveText: Take the Dusty Unsent Letter to Clerk Daltry.

quests.name: The Legend of Stalvan
quests.objectiveText: Go to The Lion's Pride Inn to see if anyone there has heard of the name Stalvan.

quests.name: The Legend of Stalvan
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve Stalvan's Undelivered Letter from the chest and deliver it to the Canal District in Stormwind.

quests.name: The Legend of Stalvan
quests.objectiveText: Search through the packed up possessions for a clue.

quests.name: The Legend of Stalvan
quests.objectiveText: The Torn Journal page you discovered provides your next clue.
